school_info.name: AMRID PUBLIC SCHOOL
school_info.tagline: Building Knowledge, Character & a Bright Future
school_info.description: Providing a holistic learning environment for child development. We combine high-quality academic training, strict discipline, standard moral values, and basic Islamic education within a safe, secure, and deeply caring setting designed to prepare children for a bright and successful future.
school_info.about_title: Where Learning Meets Values, Discipline & Care
school_info.about_text:
AMRID PUBLIC SCHOOL, located at Fatma Nagar, mandel, Baisi in Purnia, Bihar, was established in 2020 with a mission to deliver premier educational opportunities from Nursery to Class VIII.

We provide balanced trilingual academic learning in English, Hindi, and Urdu alongside foundational Islamic education. With separate residential hostels for boys and girls, round-the-clock CCTV surveillance, and a nutritious 3-time daily meal facility, our campus ensures a nurturing, secure environment where every child prospers.
school_info.admission_info: Admissions are currently open for academic session 2026–27 from Nursery to Class VIII. Parents are invited to fill the admission enquiry form online or visit the campus office for personal interaction and guided school tours.

director_info.name: Md Danish Raza
director_info.message: We established AMRID PUBLIC SCHOOL with a steadfast vision: to provide premier, value-grounded, and accessible education to families across Bihar. Our philosophy extends beyond standard rote examinations; we focus intensively on moral character, leadership qualities, trilingual mastery, and daily self-discipline. We are profoundly thankful to our parent community for their unwavering faith, which fuels our continuous pursuit of excellence.

principal_info.name: Md Noorain Raza
principal_info.message: True academic excellence emerges when educators, students, and parents collaborate with shared purpose. At AMRID PUBLIC SCHOOL, our compassionate faculty nurtures every child's innate potential from their early nursery years through Class VIII. By intertwining rigorous modern curricula with foundational moral teachings, we prepare confident, disciplined young learners equipped to succeed in higher education and life.
